in_marathi.name: Prasan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prasan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is the Lord of Prosperity and the Giver of All Good Things. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prasad', which means 'to give', and 'an', which means 'Lord'.

in_bengali.name: Prasan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Prasan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is the Lord of Prosperity and the Giver of All Good Things. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prasad', which means 'to give', and 'an', which means 'Lord'.
